proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : ∀ (l m n : Fin 3), l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {l, m, n} := by decide
  have half : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n →
      2 * EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points m) (t.points l) t.incenter = EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points m) (t.points l) (t.points n) := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    have hang : EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points l) (t.touchpoint ∅ n) =
        EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points l) (t.touchpoint ∅ m) :=
      Affine.Simplex.angle_incenter_touchpoint_eq
        (t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hln) (t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hlm)
    have s1 : Sbtw ℝ (t.points l) (t.touchpoint ∅ n) (t.points m) := t.sbtw_touchpoint_empty hln hlm hmn.symm
    have s2 : Sbtw ℝ (t.points l) (t.touchpoint ∅ m) (t.points n) := t.sbtw_touchpoint_empty hlm hln hmn
    rw [s1.angle_eq_right, s2.angle_eq_right] at hang
    have hb : EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points m) (t.points l) t.incenter = EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points l) (t.points n) := by
      rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm, hang]
    have hw1 : 0 < t.excenterWeights ∅ m := t.excenterWeights_empty_pos m
    have hw2 : 0 < t.excenterWeights ∅ n := t.excenterWeights_empty_pos n
    have hsum := t.sum_excenterWeights_eq_one_iff.2 t.excenterExists_empty
    rw [hu l m n hlm hln hmn, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlm, hln]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hmn]), Finset.sum_singleton] at hsum
    have hI : t.incenter -ᵥ t.points l = t.excenterWeights ∅ m • (t.points m -ᵥ t.points l) + t.excenterWeights ∅ n • (t.points n -ᵥ t.points l) := by
      rw [t.incenter_eq_affineCombination, ← Finset.sum_smul_vsub_const_eq_affineCombination_vsub _ _ _ _ (by rw [hu l m n hlm hln hmn, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlm, hln]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hmn]), Finset.sum_singleton]; exact hsum),
        hu l m n hlm hln hmn, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlm, hln]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hmn]), Finset.sum_singleton, vsub_self, smul_zero, zero_add]
    set a := t.excenterWeights ∅ m with ha
    set b := t.excenterWeights ∅ n with hb'
    have hκ : 0 < a + b := by positivity
    set D := AffineMap.lineMap (t.points m) (t.points n) (b / (a + b)) with hD
    have hDw : Wbtw ℝ (t.points m) D (t.points n) :=
      ⟨b / (a + b), ⟨by positivity, by rw [div_le_one hκ]; linarith⟩, rfl⟩
    have hDI : t.incenter -ᵥ t.points l = (a + b) • (D -ᵥ t.points l) := by
      have e : D -ᵥ t.points l = (t.points m -ᵥ t.points l) + (b / (a + b)) • ((t.points n -ᵥ t.points l) - (t.points m -ᵥ t.points l)) := by
        rw [hD, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right, add_comm]
      rw [hI, e, smul_add, smul_smul, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hκ.ne']
      module
    have a1 : EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points m) (t.points l) t.incenter = EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points m) (t.points l) D := by
      unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
      rw [hDI, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_right_of_pos _ _ hκ]
    have a2 : EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points l) (t.points n) = EuclideanGeometry.angle D (t.points l) (t.points n) := by
      unfold EuclideanGeometry.angle
      rw [hDI, InnerProductGeometry.angle_smul_left_of_pos _ _ hκ]
    have hadd := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_of_ne_of_ne (a := t.points l) (fun h => hlm (t.independent.injective h)) (fun h => hln (t.independent.injective h)) hDw
    rw [← a1, ← a2, ← hb] at hadd
    linarith
  have hj := half j k i hjk hij.symm hik.symm
  have hk := half k j i hjk.symm hik.symm hij.symm
  have tri := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (t.points i) (p₁ := t.points k) (p₂ := t.points j) (fun h => hjk (t.independent.injective h))
  have triI := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (t.points k) (p₁ := t.points j) (p₂ := t.incenter) (t.incenter_ne_point j)
  have c1 : EuclideanGeometry.angle t.incenter (t.points k) (t.points j) = EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points k) t.incenter := EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm _ _ _
  have c2 : EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points i) (t.points k) (t.points j) = EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points k) (t.points i) := EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm _ _ _
  rw [c1] at triI
  rw [c2] at tri
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) t.incenter (t.points k) = Real.pi / 2 + EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.points k) / 2
